primitives.breakdown_regime: When injury data is missing or team aliases mismatched, C_matchup = 0.

primitives.name: Trench Analysis Logic
primitives.verbatim_quote: Only appends a chain `if down:` (if opposing DL front has an injured player on report).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_{\\text{DL}} \\in \\{0, 1\\}': 'Binary indicator for injured DL player', 'C_{\\text{trench}} \\in \\{0, 1\\}': 'Chain generated for trench analysis'}
primitives.assumptions: Trench chain generation requires a defensive front injury; otherwise no chain is appended.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D_DL = 0, C_trench = 0 regardless of other inputs.

layer2.mapping: Trench chain logic is a derived kernel from injury data and DL position mapping in GSE's state space.
layer2.telemetry: Injury report flags for DL players

primitives.name: Depth Chart Consistency Check
primitives.verbatim_quote: ocs/data-sources/research/2026-10-13/depthcharts/espn-depthcharts-2026.json`: Complete 32-team depth charts with OL starters (LT/LG/C/RG/RT), Defensive Front starters (DE/DT/NT/EDGE), and Secondary starters (LCB/RCB/NB/SS/FS).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_{\\text{chart}}^{\\text{team}}': 'Complete depth chart for team', 'A_{\\text{alias}}^{\\text{team}}': 'Normalized team alias used in data pipeline'}
primitives.assumptions: All 32 teams have complete depth charts; team aliases must be normalized for consistency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Mismatched aliases cause lookup failures, leading to incomplete data processing.

layer2.mapping: Depth chart structure maps to GSI's data fusion layer, ensuring alignment of positional roles across teams.
layer2.telemetry: Presence of full depth chart entries per team
